question: Should this maintainer-labelled QA retry change proceed based on the successful proof workflow, or should it include direct redacted post-fix live output before merge?
rationale: The implementation is narrow, but the public PR body documents only the pre-fix live failure; maintainer intent is needed to decide whether the linked workflow is sufficient evidence for this internal QA reliability change.

options.title: Request direct live recovery proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted after-fix run that shows the retryable history error followed by the expected reply within the existing timeout.

options.title: Accept the linked proof workflow
options.body: Treat the successful Real behavior proof workflow as sufficient after a maintainer inspects its artifact and confirms it exercises the claimed recovery path.

recommendation.title: Request direct live recovery proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted after-fix run that shows the retryable history error followed by the expected reply within the existing timeout.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied both the detailed reproduction and the proposed QA-boundary repair, so they are the clearest available contact for the requested evidence.
